"import os
import shutil
import sys

_real_python = os.environ.get("SWIFTPYTHON_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE") or os.environ.get("PYTHONEXECUTABLE")
if not _real_python:
    _real_python = shutil.which("python3") or shutil.which("python")
if _real_python:
    sys.executable = _real_python"

"KEYMAPOPTS="us us"
HOSTNAMEOPTS="-n swiftpython-vm"
INTERFACESOPTS="auto lo
iface lo inet loopback

auto eth0
iface eth0 inet dhcp"
TIMEZONEOPTS="-z UTC"
PROXYOPTS="none"
APKREPOSOPTS="-1"
USEROPTS="-a -u -g audio,video,netdev user"
NTPOPTS="-c chrony"
SSHDOPTS="none"
DISKOPTS="-m sys /dev/vda""

"#!/sbin/openrc-run
command="/usr/local/bin/swiftpython-supervisor"
command_background=true
pidfile="/run/swiftpython-supervisor.pid"
command_user="root"

start_pre() {
    mkdir -p /run/swiftpython-config
    mount -t virtiofs swiftpython-config /run/swiftpython-config 2>/dev/null || true
    if [ -f /run/swiftpython-config/supervisor.env ]; then
        set -a
        . /run/swiftpython-config/supervisor.env
        set +a
    fi
}"
